definitions: A 2017 survival platformer video game developed by Videocult and published by Adult Swim Games and Akupara Games.
The fictional setting or universe in which the video game 'Rain World' takes place, characterized by a post-apocalyptic ecosystem and a perpetual cycle of deadly rain.
examples: Many players find the ecosystem in Rain World to be challenging.
The slugcat is the protagonist in Rain World.
Rain World is known for its unique animation style.
